summary: 60-year-old man from Louisville lost his balance while mountain biking on the Walker Loop Trail just north of South Boulder Creek, injuring his ankle; an RMRG rescuer and a Boulder County Open Space ranger drove a side-by-side trail vehicle to him and transported him to an AMR ambulance, which took him to a Boulder area hospital with non-life-threatening injuries (~1.5-hr rescue; BCSO case 21-3865)
location: Walker Loop Trail, north of South Boulder Creek
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Boulder County Sheriff's Office, Boulder County Open Space, American Medical Response
